summary.ja: 2次元TMzの真空・斜めFresnel界面・四辺と角のPMLを固定入力で検証。
summary.en: Validate 2D TMz vacuum, oblique Fresnel interfaces and four-side/corner PML with fixed inputs.

references.label: Numerical solution of initial boundary value problems involving maxwell's equations in isotropic media (1966)
references.scope: Method-specific source; see the detailed reading for source role and actual review depth.

references.label: Fadime Bekmambetova and Xinyue Zhang and Piero Triverio (2017). A Dissipation Theory for Three-Dimensional FDTD with Application to Stability Analysis and Subgridding
references.scope: Research preprint v2; energy Eq26 and strict CFL Eq35 consulted. Not a claim to implement its subgridding method.

references.label: Jean-Pierre Bérenger (1994). A Perfectly Matched Layer for the Absorption of Electromagnetic Waves
references.scope: Original split-field PML publication: bibliographic identity and abstract checked. Original full text was not available for inspection. The implemented reduction and discrete balance are derived and tested separately; consult Johnson for the matched-layer interpretation.

references.label: Steven G. Johnson (2021). Notes on Perfectly Matched Layers (PMLs)
references.scope: Author notes, selected sections 4.1–4.2 and 7.1–7.3: matching electric and magnetic damping, anisotropic interpretation, discretization reflections and incidence limitations. Not a complete audit of every PML formulation.

references.label: Markus Zahn (2003). Electromagnetic Field Theory: A Problem Solving Approach
references.scope: Author textbook, selected sections 7-6-1 and 7-6-2, printed pages 522–524 (PDF pages 36–38): tangential E/H continuity, normal-incidence field reflection/transmission and impedance weighting of power. A textbook exposition, not an original Fresnel publication.

assumptions: Selected lossless nonmagnetic s-polarized dielectric packets with propagating transmission; retained vacuum and PML cases.
units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields.
boundary_conditions: Oblique interface: periodic y and distant PEC x caps before main return, no PML. Retained periodic/PEC and x/four-side/corner PML cases.

next_deliverable.ja: p偏光、全反射、損失・分散媒質と3次元を別に検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separately validate p polarization, total internal reflection, loss/dispersion and 3D.

limitations.ja: 2次元TMzの教育用例。真空モード、垂直誘電体界面、左右x方向PML、四辺・角PMLに加え、第4版で指定した無損失非磁性界面へのs偏光斜め波束をFresnel解・反射透過エネルギー・流束収支・格子収束で検証。p偏光・全反射・損失分散・一般媒質・3次元の包括的な実証ではない。
limitations.en: Educational 2D TMz: retained vacuum modes, normal dielectric interface, x-PML and four-side/corner PML; r4 validates selected s-polarized oblique packets at a lossless nonmagnetic interface using Fresnel fields, packet R/T, flux balance and refinement. Not blanket validation of p polarization, total internal reflection, loss/dispersion, general media or 3D.

metadata_review.level: Original educational 2D TMz code with continuum/discrete analytic checks, refinement, energy and independent ZIP rerun.

assumptions_ja: 指定した無損失・非磁性界面のs偏光波束と伝播する透過波。従来の真空・PML例も保持。
units_ja: 無次元。長さ・時間・場を規格化。
boundary_conditions_ja: 斜め界面：y周期、主要な戻り波より前の時間窓で遠方PEC x外端、PMLなし。従来の周期/PEC・左右x方向/四辺/角PMLも保持。
run_commands: python -m pytest -q test_fdtd.py test_scattering.py test_corner.py test_oblique.py
